name: DBB_DisSeg
summary: Segments a T1-weighted brain image into CSF, gray matter, white matter, deep gray matter, brainstem and cerebellum with the DBB 3D U-Net (DisSeg, TensorFlow), after ANTs histogram matching.
description: Histogram-matches the T1w to a reference image with ANTs ImageMath, then predicts a six-class tissue segmentation inside the given brain mask with the 3D U-Net used as baseline in the Distorted Brain Benchmark (DBB) for paediatric patients with brain malformations. Use it for tissue segmentation of T1w images, including distorted or paediatric brains. Needs a brain mask aligned with the T1w; the prediction container runs with GPU support (singularity --nv).

inputs.description: Brain mask of the T1w image, used to restrict the prediction.

outputs.description: Tissue segmentation (segmentation.nii.gz) with label.json: 1 CSF, 2 gray matter, 3 white matter, 4 deep gray matter, 5 brainstem, 6 cerebellum.

citations.text: Amorosino G., Peruzzo D., Redaelli D., Olivetti E., Arrigoni F., Avesani P. DBB - A Distorted Brain Benchmark for Automatic Tissue Segmentation in Paediatric Patients. NeuroImage 119486 (2022).
